title: X1 ejecta-conditions boundary artifact
description: Downstream boundary artifact of the X1 cross-sequence bridge: one file per scenario, published by NuclearMatter-Backend for the n2n / Genesis_LANL side. Contract source: n2n_paper scoping/X1-BRIDGE.md section 4. Design notes and ambiguity resolutions: docs/x1-interface.md in this repo. Version v0.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file conforms to.

provenance.description: Required provenance header, same convention as the frib_scenarios ladder: a file without a complete header is invalid.

commit.description: Git commit of the generating repo.

generator.description: Path of the generator script within the repo, e.g. scripts/export_x1_ejecta.py.

citations.description: Upstream data citations: which NR fitting formulae and simulation sets (e.g. 'Radice et al. 2018, ApJ 869, 130, arXiv:1809.11161, Eqs. 18-25').

notes.description: Free-form caveats (e.g. clamp-active fiducial warnings, assumption flags for scenario-level s/tau).

scenario.description: Scenario definition: fiducial binary and fiducial NEPs at which everything (values and Jacobians) is evaluated. No binary marginalization in v0 (docs/x1-interface.md A5).

name.description: Short scenario identifier, unique within the exchange.

chi1.description: Aligned spin, primary. Informational in v0: implemented fit families ignore spin.

nep_fiducial.description: Fiducial NEP values (MeV where dimensional), keyed by the same names as nep_names.

eos_family.description: Which EOS family produced Lambda(m), R(m), e.g. 'nmbackend MetaModelEOS + causal tail, build_family'.

nep_names.description: Ordered NEP parameter names (e.g. E_sym, L_sym, K_sat, cs2_tail). All Jacobian rows in this file are aligned with this order. Consumers must index by name, never by assumed position (docs/x1-interface.md A4).

components.description: Labeled ejecta components (fitting formulae differ per component). The Y_e quadrature is per-component in v0 (docs/x1-interface.md A3).

uq.description: Uncertainty-carrying quantity, matching nmbackend.ejecta.UQ: never a bare number. sigma = quadrature sum of sigma_fit and sigma_formula (docs/x1-interface.md A1).

sigma_formula.description: Spread across independent fit families on the same inputs.

ranged_value.description: Scenario-level quantity with a stated range (used for s, tau when the surrogate does not resolve them per node; every number an assumption, flagged in provenance.notes).

jacobian_row.description: d(quantity)/d(NEP) for each entry of nep_names, in order, evaluated at the fiducial binary and fiducial NEPs. Exact zeros are stated, not omitted (including the identically-zero rows for scenario-level s, tau in v0).

node.description: One Y_e quadrature node discretizing P(Y_e | binary, EOS) for this component.

weight.description: Quadrature weight; weights sum to 1 within the component (mass scale carried by m_ej).

s_kb_per_baryon.description: Per-node entropy, only if the surrogate resolves it; else omit and use the component-level s.

tau_ms.description: Per-node expansion timescale (density e-folding time of the exponential phase, X1-BRIDGE section 3 convention; docs/x1-interface.md A7). Only if resolved per node.

label.description: Ejecta component label; the fitting formulae differ per component.

fit_families.description: Registry names of the fit families combined for this component (e.g. radice2018, kf2020, nedora2021).

m_ej_msun.description: Component ejecta mass in solar masses.

v_ej_c.description: Optional mass-weighted ejecta velocity in units of c.

s_kb_per_baryon.description: Component-level entropy with range; required in v0 unless every node carries s_kb_per_baryon.

tau_ms.description: Component-level expansion timescale with range; required in v0 unless every node carries tau_ms.

ye_quadrature.description: Nodes {Y_e,k} with weights {w_k}; weights sum to 1 within this component. Node placement should bracket the lanthanide turn-on (Y_e,crit ~ 0.26).
